case_title: PUMPHREY, E. NELL VS MACY'S DEPT STORE-MR JEFF GERNETTEE, STORE MGR

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY PUMPHREY, E. NELL AS TO DEFENDANT MACY'S DEPT STORE-MR JEFF GERNETTEE, STORE MGR ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-21-1998 AT 06:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT MACY'S DEPT STORE-MR JEFF GERNETTEE, STORE MGR

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF PUMPHREY, E. NELL IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT MACY'S DEPT STORE-MR JEFF GERNETTEE, STORE MGR MACY'S IS TO PICK UP SOFA BED FROM PLFT'S RESIDENC WITHIN 30 DAYS OF THIS ORDER. WITHIN THE SAME STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
THE SAME PERIOD OF TIME MACY'S IS TO RETURN ALL MONIES PAID BY PLFT TOWARD THE PURCHASE PRICE AND IS TO CREDIT PLFT MACY'S ACCT FOR THE REMAINDER OF
THE PURCHASE PRICE AND ALL ACCUMMULATED INT. AND FINANCE CHARGES RELATING TO PURCHASE OF SOFA BED. PLFT TO COOPERATE WITH MACY SO THAT BED CAN PICKED
